title: Start here
blurb: What a program is, the terminal, files, pipes and your first scripts.

title: Git
blurb: Save every step of your work, go back in time, and work with other people.

title: Bash scripting
blurb: Scripts that take options, process text, survive odd input and fail safely.

title: C
blurb: How the machine really works: memory, pointers, and building programs from several files.

title: Python
blurb: The fastest way to get things done: from first functions to classes, generators, tests and type hints.

title: Data structures and algorithms
blurb: From Big-O to graphs, dynamic programming and segment trees. Solve the exercises in any language.

title: SQL and PostgreSQL
blurb: Ask a database questions, design tables that reject bad data, and keep queries fast.

title: HTML
blurb: The structure of every web page: text, links, images, tables, forms, and markup that works for everyone.

title: CSS
blurb: Make pages look right: selectors, the box model, flexbox, grid, and layouts that adapt to any screen.

title: Java
blurb: A strictly typed, object-oriented language: classes, interfaces, collections, generics and streams.

title: Go
blurb: A small, fast, compiled language made for servers and tools: slices, structs, interfaces, goroutines and an HTTP API.

title: Rust
blurb: Speed of C with memory safety checked by the compiler: ownership, enums, traits and iterators.

title: Elixir
blurb: Functional programming on the BEAM: pattern matching, recursion, pipelines, processes and GenServer.

title: JavaScript and TypeScript
blurb: The language of the web, from first functions to a REST API, types and the browser.

title: PHP
blurb: The language behind a large part of the web: arrays, functions, classes, forms, JSON APIs and a database with PDO.

title: React
blurb: User interfaces from components: props, state, lists, forms, effects, data and shared state.

title: Next.js
blurb: Full web applications with React: file-based routes, server rendering, API endpoints and server actions.

title: Docker
blurb: Package any program with everything it needs, and run several containers together with Compose.

title: Microservices
blurb: Several small services in containers: calls between them, a gateway, a queue with a worker, and surviving failure.
